messages:
sam_support: Hey — CX reported invoice INV-2026-03-47 where dashboard shows ~620 tokens for a session but invoice charged 2,160 tokens. They attached a session id and say they streamed and hit cancel mid-response. sess=abc123-stream-01, correlation=crl-79e2.
max_billing: Can you paste the invoice id + the exact session id from the customer? I want to pull ledger rows.
sam_support: INV-2026-03-47, sess=abc123-stream-01 (same as above). Customer claim: stream began, multiple SSE chunks, client aborted after final chunk started. They attached network trace showing FIN after last data frame.
jess_eng: Thanks — quick hypothesis: we may be double-counting when a session replays final chunks across multiplexed connections (customer used our multiplexed SSE client). Or conversely, we might be attributing an orphaned finalization to a different session. Need logs.
rachel_sre: Also check whether final 'trailer' event was sent by server or client_ack path got suppressed when the TCP FIN raced with write. We had a bug in kv-finalize once where the finalize ack was not idempotent across reconnects.
sam_support: Pasting minimal repro steps customer shared (they said they could reproduce locally):
```
# open two SSE connections multiplexed over same websocket (pseudo)
curl -N \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?sess=abc123\" -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \n# send a prompt that yields multiple chunks, then client closes socket mid-chunk
# network trace: 
# -> data: {"type":"chunk","tokens":420}\n# -> data: {"type":"final","tokens":200}\n# client closes immediately after first bytes of final frame
```
sam_support: They say dashboard shows 620 tokens but invoice got 2,160 (roughly +1,540). They suspect some replay path is counting tokens again when another connection (or our reconnect) finalizes the session.
max_billing: I pulled ledger rows for INV-2026-03-47: there are three ledger entries for sess abc123: one for 620, one for 820, one for 720. That sums to 2,160. Something is writing multiple finalize events. Correlation crl-79e2 appears in all three.
jess_eng: Ok that points to duplicate finalize writes. Hypothesis: on SSE reconnect we run finalize() if we see EOF and we also process a separate 'session-trailer' event from the runtime, so both paths write to ledger without acquire lock. Could be race in finalize idempotency.
rachel_sre: Assigning to eng-runtime to audit finalize path and to billing to add temporary guard to dedupe final ledger writes by correlation id. @jess_eng can you run a quick grep for finalize(correlation) in runtime diff?
jess_eng: On it. Also capturing a small stack log from customer shows:
```
2026-03-12T18:22:11Z INFO stream: chunk 1 tokens=420 sess=abc123 corl=crl-79e2
2026-03-12T18:22:14Z WARN stream: EOF detected, running finalize(sess=abc123)
2026-03-12T18:22:14Z INFO billing: write_ledger(sess=abc123, tokens=620, corl=crl-79e2)
2026-03-12T18:22:14Z ERROR stream: trailer event arrived while finalize inflight -> scheduling second finalize
2026-03-12T18:22:14Z INFO billing: write_ledger(sess=abc123, tokens=820, corl=crl-79e2)
2026-03-12T18:22:15Z INFO billing: write_ledger(sess=abc123, tokens=720, corl=crl-79e2)
```
jess_eng: That log is gold. It shows finalize raced with trailer handler. We're missing an atomic dedupe on billing write keyed by (session_id, corl, finalize_version).
max_billing: For mitigation I can dedupe ledger writes at billing ingestion by dropping subsequent writes within 10s that share the same correlation id and session id. That should reduce customer impact quickly.
rachel_sre: Good. Also add a monitoring rule: alert if more than 1 billing write for same session in 30s.
jess_eng: I'll open a runtime PR to make finalize idempotent (check-and-set finalize state before writing) and add a test that simulates concurrent trailer + EOF path.
sam_support: I'll reply to the customer: initial response — we see duplicate finalization writes; mitigation plan: billing will dedupe incoming ledger writes within 10s, engineering will patch runtime finalize to be idempotent, and we'll follow up with a corrected invoice within 48h.
max_billing: I'll also mark INV-2026-03-47 as 'investigating' on billing side and create a credit hold so they aren't charged until we confirm.
infra-bot: deploy bot: queued 1 job: patch-billing-dedupe v1 -> env:prod (manual approval required).
sam_support: Thanks all. @jess_eng @max_billing please post PR/CR links here when available and cc me on customer update. :thumbsup:
